summary: HEICO filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement and issuance of $550M 4.950% Senior Notes due 2031 and $650M 5.400% Senior Notes due 2036, completed on July 16, 2026. Net proceeds will repay borrowings under an existing credit facility. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing senior debt, issued under a shelf registration statement. Interest is payable semi-annually; notes are redeemable at HEICO's option before and after par call dates. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
